research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01: official biography, State Library oral history, Commissioner2013 report, ABC2017 and2023 profiles and Greens/advocacy network material searched. No identified substantive paid ordinary employer recovered.

Follow-up: identify youth/disability advocacy organisations and any paid projects or conference honoraria, personal hours and dates; Rockingham youth body historical minutes; education dates/leave. Advisory roles may overlap generic advocacy entries.
Record remains unresolved. Student status, volunteering and family financial circumstances are not proof that no private/public paid work ever occurred. No inferred zero totals.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: historical health annual reports reveal previously unrecorded paid Rockingham health advisory-council service. Added separately from city youth council/Commissioner reference-group participation; payment evidence does not establish employment status or hours.

Searched earlier/later health-report references and appointment leads; no exact tenure or substantive full-time work recovered. Public professional profile https://au.linkedin.com/in/jordon-steele-john-656ba917a/ returned (999) Unknown Status Code. Official alternate annual-report PDF downloaded and extracted after web open/screenshot access failures. These are source-specific gaps, not terminal errors.

Next leads: appointment and cessation minutes for Rockingham health council; 2014–15 and 2017–18 remuneration/appointments; other paid disability/youth projects and conference honoraria, precise education and leave history. No zero total inferred from absence of other identified employers.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: targeted searches for the Rockingham health council appointment and pre-Senate advocacy employment recovered only the already-cited official 2015–16 and 2016–17 remuneration tables and generic contemporaneous advocate descriptions. No new appointment boundary, employer, remuneration or hours evidence was found. The source avenues were documented to avoid treating repeated search results as new evidence; the record remains unresolved.
